test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Mechanic Diesel) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

Some ships are boats.

All boats are submarines.

Some submarines are yachts

Conclusions:

(I) Some yachts are boats.

(II) Some yachts are ships.
solution:
Least possible Venn diagram,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/37952dbc51cf46fe92f6a5abc529fcbc8e8bd770c26ef98d2cda97ae24cdf27d.png] 

**Conclusions:****

(I) Some yachts are boats → Does not follow (There is no direct relation given between yachts and boats. it is possible not definite).

(II) Some yachts are ships → Does not follow (There is no direct relation given between yachts and ships. it is possible not definite).

Neither
 conclusion (I) nor (II) follows.

Hence, the correct answer is “Option 4**”.
